description.value: Ginger & Chili is a Szechuan-influenced Chinese restaurant in Vancouver's Point Grey neighbourhood, known for dishes like ginger beef, spicy wonton in garlic sauce, and a broad seafood menu. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, online ordering, and full catering packages for private events. Customer reviews consistently highlight fresh ingredients and a welcoming, homestyle atmosphere.
